remarks: Prepare to be wowed by this stunning, sun-drenched condo where luxury meets ultimate convenience! The moment you step inside, you will love the massive living room, completely transformed by dramatic 16+ foot soaring ceilings that flood the space with natural light. The seamless open-concept kitchen and dining area flow effortlessly onto your own private patio-perfect for morning coffee. This level boasts two oversized bedrooms, two beautifully updated bathrooms, and the ultimate city luxury: in-unit laundry. Upstairs, a versatile bonus loft awaits your imagination, ready to become the ultimate home office, media lounge, or guest retreat. Live the resort lifestyle in a premier building packed with first-class amenities! Enjoy the peace of mind of an on-site concierge, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and secure Amazon lockers for seamless package delivery. Best of all? Two coveted garage parking spots are included! Positioned right in the heart of it all, you are just steps from Mill River Park and a mere 5 minutes from I-95, Metro-North, and vibrant Downtown Stamford. This is urban living at its absolute finest-don't miss out! This incredible property is also listed for rent.
